mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.2%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in low-production regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in housing starts (HOUST above 500.0) reflects strong consumer confidence and construction activity that correlates with rising corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) combined with near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) indicates a liquidity trap where monetary policy fails to stimulate growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate increases exceeding 0.25% in a single month signal active monetary tightening that reduces liquidity and raises borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
